exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-22T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix mail-

exec card --actor worker mail subscribe 'release/*' --ttl 1m
exec card --actor scheduler mail send worker --ttl 1m 'temporary notice'

# Refresh keeps the original subscription identity and extends its retention.
at 2026-07-22T12:00:30Z
exec card --actor worker --json mail subscribe 'release/*' --ttl 2m
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/refreshed.jsonl
exec card --actor observer --json mail subscribe 'build/ready'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/default.jsonl
exec card --actor archive --json mail subscribe 'release/*' --ttl 240h
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/capped.jsonl

# Expired direct mail is purged while the refreshed subscription remains active.
at 2026-07-22T12:01:00Z
exec card --actor worker mail recv --peek
! stdout .
exec card --actor scheduler --json mail publish release/ready 'release notice'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/published.jsonl
exec card --actor worker --json mail recv --peek
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/worker.jsonl

# An expired subscription no longer participates in later publication.
at 2026-07-22T12:02:30Z
exec card --actor scheduler mail publish release/ready 'late notice'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/published-after-expiry.txt
exec card --json mail subscriptions
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/active.jsonl

-- golden/refreshed.jsonl --
{"listener":"worker","pattern":"release/*","created":"2026-07-22T12:00:00Z","expires":"2026-07-22T12:02:30Z"}
-- golden/default.jsonl --
{"listener":"observer","pattern":"build/ready","created":"2026-07-22T12:00:30Z","expires":"2026-07-22T12:15:30Z"}
-- golden/capped.jsonl --
{"listener":"archive","pattern":"release/*","created":"2026-07-22T12:00:30Z","expires":"2026-07-29T12:00:30Z"}
-- golden/published.jsonl --
{"id":"mail_00000000000000000000000000000002","sender":"scheduler","recipient":"archive","source_topic":"release/ready","body":"release notice","created":"2026-07-22T12:01:00Z","expires":"2026-07-29T12:01:00Z","read_at":null}
{"id":"mail_00000000000000000000000000000003","sender":"scheduler","recipient":"worker","source_topic":"release/ready","body":"release notice","created":"2026-07-22T12:01:00Z","expires":"2026-07-29T12:01:00Z","read_at":null}
-- golden/worker.jsonl --
{"id":"mail_00000000000000000000000000000003","sender":"scheduler","recipient":"worker","source_topic":"release/ready","body":"release notice","created":"2026-07-22T12:01:00Z","expires":"2026-07-29T12:01:00Z","read_at":null}
-- golden/published-after-expiry.txt --
mail_00000000000000000000000000000004	scheduler	archive	release/ready	2026-07-22T12:02:30Z	2026-07-29T12:02:30Z
late notice
-- golden/active.jsonl --
{"listener":"archive","pattern":"release/*","created":"2026-07-22T12:00:30Z","expires":"2026-07-29T12:00:30Z"}
{"listener":"observer","pattern":"build/ready","created":"2026-07-22T12:00:30Z","expires":"2026-07-22T12:15:30Z"}
